title: Decoder floors, case (c): the A2 family of non-B-form rank-9 realisations (P112 ≥ 64, #968 P104 ≥ 56, E8 ≥ 72; no κ claim)
body:
**Status: research note with exact finite computations and written proofs (not a SAT/DRAT proof). No κ claim, no supplier word.** Only `research/a2-family-decoder-floors/` is added; nothing existing is changed.

## What this proves (scope is the claim)

Model of #2338 / #2277 / #2724: exact masked decoders `N = Σ_{j≤m} p_j q_jᵀ` of a pattern realisation (zero on orthogonal pairs, nonzero elsewhere on the diagonal and off it: the "iff pattern"), arbitrary factors over a field of characteristic 0, dense pairing table `B`, cost `Σ_j rank_F2 B[R_j, A_j]`.

* **A1/A2: the A2 family.** For P112, P104 and E8 there are rank-9 iff-pattern realisations that equal the Gram matrix except on the three rows of one A2 triangle, where each row is the Gram row rescaled by one factor on `N̄(u_i) ∩ O_{u_j}` and another on `N̄(u_i) ∩ O_{u_k}` (7 parameters plus diagonal scalings). They are **not of B-form** `D₁GD₂ + cβᵀ` (with `c_uβ_s = 0` on orthogonal pairs): a counterexample to our working "Conjecture B" for rank-9 realisations. Exact certificate (three random exact members per unit, plus the two tie members below).
* **Theorem G (PROVEN).** If the rows outside a set `X` of a rank-9 pattern realisation are Gram rows, it is B-form with `supp c ⊆ X`, or in the A2 family on an A2 triangle inside `X` (columns: transposed). **Lemma E (PROVEN)**: rank ≤ 8 on `V∖X` plus a rigid sub-unit (#1212 and extensions) gives Gram rows. The existence step ("every rank-9 realisation has such an `X`") is **OPEN** and not claimed.
* **Floors (F).** Every 9-term (square) decoder of **every** A2-family member, at all parameters and on all A2 triangles, costs **P112 ≥ 64, P104 (#968's unit) ≥ 56, E8 ≥ 72**. Triangle coverage: P112 one orbit of 896, E8 one orbit of 1120, P104 ≤ 28 orbits (all 28 representatives run). Case I (some row normal ∥ `e_9`) and Case II (none; II(b) by an exact class-level min-cost relaxation, 65 / 62 / 74 off the B-locus, 66 / 63 / 75 on it, using the checked fact that two merged column classes are co-killable only on `γ₂ = γ₃`); includes the E8 near-miss (the three punctured normals `r_1, r_2, r_3` are dependent).
* **Sharpness (S).** Exact tie decoders of cost **64 (P112)** and **72 (E8)** at the stated special parameter points (exact over Q, independently re-evaluated; the tie members are certified non-B-form); the generic members checked reach only 65 / 73. P104 sharpness is not claimed.
* **`m ≥ 10`, both factors in the realisation's two 9-dimensional spaces (M), off the B-locus `γ₂ ≠ γ₃`.** Cost ≥ **68 (P112), 64 (P104), 77 (E8)** (merge lemma + exact class-level min-cost relaxation). On the B-locus the relaxation is lower (62 / 58 / 70) and that case is **open**.

## Not covered (stated up front)

* **Decoders with factors outside `col M` / `row M` on the A2 family with `m ≥ 10` are NOT covered** (for `m = 10` they are exactly the one-sided frame-expansion decoders; only a heuristic search was done, which found ties and nothing proven).
* **Other rank-9 realisations**: this is one explicit family, not all of case (c). In particular nothing here bears on the co-star decoders (Discussion 1267, #1320) unless their realisation lies in the family.
* **`m ≥ 10` on the B-locus `γ₂ = γ₃`**: open (not claimed).
* Non-iff patterns, `B` of rank ≥ 10, other P104 units. Not claimed: that the A2 family is an irreducible component; the variant of the non-B-form statement without the orthogonal-pair condition.

## Labels (every step is in the README)

PROVEN: square-decoder normal form, merge lemma, A2 facts, the construction, Theorem G, Lemma E, the non-B-form argument, Case I and II(a). PROVEN from CHECKED: Case II(b) (row census parameter-free, column census treats `γ` symbolically; merged-kill fact; class-level relaxation) and `m ≥ 10` off the B-locus. CHECKED (exact computation): members with the iff pattern and rank 9; rank certificates (mod p, safe direction); span facts S1/S2; the unit census on all three units and all 28 P104 representatives; survivor-pair ranks; the row-puncture floors `P_k` (exact branch-and-bound on P112/P104, structural on E8); the tie decoders; exact optima at fixed members (65 / 64 / 73 / 72); the merged-kill fact (P112, E8, all 28 P104 representatives); the class-level relaxations; pair tables at the members checked (corroboration). **RECORDED (logs shipped, hash-pinned, headline lines asserted, not re-run):** the robust CP-SAT / CEGAR runs over all parameters (no square decoder ≤ 63 on P112, ≤ 71 on E8) and the all-parameter special-locus census behind the pair tables.

## Verification

`bash research/a2-family-decoder-floors/verify.sh /fresh/dir` (Python ≥ 3.11, `numpy`, `networkx`; one process at a time; no SAT solver). On a fresh `git archive` export: **102 PASS, 0 FAIL**, 941 s wall (15.4 min user CPU, one process at a time, `nice 10`; venv Python 3.14, numpy 2.5, networkx 3.7).

**What `verify.sh` re-runs:** units; survivor classes and survivor-pair ranks; S1/S2; exact A2 members and the non-B certificate on all three units; the unit census (replayed and compared line for line with the recorded logs) on the first triangle of each unit and all 28 P104 representatives; triangle-orbit counts; `P_k` and the case arithmetic; the merged-kill fact and the Case II(b) / `m ≥ 10` class-level relaxations (P112, E8, all 28 P104 representatives); the tie decoders and the tie members' certificates; exact optima at fixed members; pair tables at members (corroboration). **RECORDED, not re-run:** the CP-SAT / CEGAR logs and special-locus census (`evidence/logs/hunt-a2/`, pinned in `MANIFEST.sha256`).

## Overlap

Searched (2026-10-15): "A2 family / triangle / subsystem", "rank 9 / rank-9 / rank nine realisation", "non-B-form", "B-form", "Conjecture B", "square decoder", "decoder floor", "masked P112 decoder", "co-star", "rank-8 rigidity", "non-Gram rank" and the unit sizes. No PR body found that states an A2-family (non-B-form) rank-9 realisation, Theorem G / Lemma E, or these floors. Nearest: #2338 / #2724 (ours; case (c) open item and sibling), #1212 and extensions (rank 8 only), #2321 / #2385 / #2398 / #2515 (one fixed rank-9 P112 completion under a COPY-power cost). Bodies read, proofs not; discussions not searched.

Parents: #2338 (open item "factors outside `col M`, `m ≥ 9`", case (c)), #2724, #2639, #2277 (ours). Cited from their statements: #1212, #1389, #1399, #1419, #1425, #1616 (rank-8 rigidity, used only to state Lemma E), #968 (the P104 unit), #1224, #1180, #1320, D1267 (context, not covered).
